master_script_prompt: Escribe como Radar IA: espanol claro, rapido, anti-humo, con energia de operador. Explica una noticia/trend de IA en 45-65 segundos. Estructura: que paso, por que importa, ejemplo concreto, que hacer hoy. No inventes datos. Cita fuente. No prometas ingresos. No uses tono guru. Cierra con una accion concreta y una frase de marca.
master_visual_prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 premium AI news short for a fictional channel called Radar IA. Style: cinematic tech newsroom, operator dashboard, modern motion graphics, clean high-contrast lighting, realistic but slightly animated, not cartoon, not anime, not childish. Show abstract AI agents, workflow nodes, dashboards, browser panels, data cards, glowing signal lines and clean subtitle-safe area. No real company logos unless provided and licensed, no fake UI claims, no private data, no celebrity likeness, no distorted text. Leave space for editor-added Spanish text.
